doc: I106's candidate list (docs/BUILD_PLAN.md §4 I106, HUMAN_ANSWERS Q54 as relayed in the I106 brief). Written before any draw, from names and URLs only: no candidate repository was opened, listed or fetched to write it. spec/M6/lib/I106_draw.py draws 2 of these by commit-reveal; the list's order plays no part in the draw.

criteria.C1_well_known: Listed in DefiLlama's top 30 protocols by TVL, or in L2BEAT's top 20 rollups by total value secured, at the snapshot 2025-01-01. Membership is asserted from the sealer's knowledge of those public lists and was not fetched for this file; the human can check it against the lists' archives (reported under Questions for the human).
criteria.C2_multi_component: The on-chain system is several contracts that call each other (not a single contract or a single token).
criteria.C3_upgrade_history: Its mainnet deployment has been upgraded at least once after launch: a proxy implementation change, or a governance-executed module replacement.
criteria.C4_public_repo: Its source is in a public GitHub repository under the project's own organisation; the URL is the canonical one.
criteria.C5_frontend_language: The system's core is written in Solidity or Go, the two languages HOLON's frontends read.
criteria.excluded: Morph; Scroll; I48's corpus systems (arbitrum, compound, cosmos, go-ethereum, optimism, wormhole, spec/eval/corpus.json) and their forks (OP-stack chains, Arbitrum Orbit chains, geth forks, Cosmos-SDK chains, Compound forks); across-protocol (analysed earlier in this repo); Aave forks (Spark). Systems that meet C1 but fail another criterion are left out, e.g. Uniswap and Morpho Blue (immutable core: no C3), Curve (Vyper: no C5), Starknet (Cairo: no C5).
